dialog.english:
Tai! What happened? WarGreymon
stopped moving!
dialog.translation:
Tai! Qué ha pasado?
WarGreymon dejó de moverse!

dialog.english: Huh? What?
Sorry about that...

Izzy, the computer's not
working.
What happened?!

I didn't do anything? Why'd you
have to go to the bathroom at the
most important time?
dialog.translation:
Yo no hice nada! Por qué
tuviste que ir al baño
justo en el momento clave?

dialog.english:
It's not working... What did you
do? Why did you make it freeze?
dialog.translation:
No funciona... Qué hiciste?
Por qué lo dejaste congelado?

dialog.english: It wasn't on purpose!

See, this is why you get into
fights with Sora!
dialog.translation:
Por eso es por lo que te
peleas con Sora!

dialog.english:
I... I didn't... I just wanted to
get her a present...
dialog.translation:
Yo... yo no... solo quería
regalarle algo...

dialog.english: A present?

Her birthday was coming up, so I
got her a hairpin, but...
dialog.translation:
Se acercaba su cumple y le
compré una horquilla, pero...

dialog.english:
She started saying stuff like "Oh,
so you don't think this hat looks
good on me?"...
dialog.translation:
Y empezó con que "Ah, o sea
que este sombrero no me
queda bien?"...

dialog.english: So that was it?
But I apologized, you know!
It's back!
Aaaaaah... WarGreymon!

Tai! Izzy! You idiots!
What were you up to?
dialog.translation:
Tai! Izzy! Serán idiotas!
Qué estabais haciendo?

dialog.english:
WarGreymon! WarGreymon!
WarGreymooooooon!
T-Tai...

If I could be there... If I could
be right next to you...
dialog.translation:
Si pudiera estar allí... Si
pudiera estar a tu lado...

dialog.english: "You lost again?"
What?!
That was from Canberra...

"You were almost there, too. What
the heck?"
dialog.translation:
"Tú también estabas cerca.
Qué te pasó?"

dialog.english: This one's from Berlin...
Put a lid on it!
I'm just reading all the emails!
Why, you, Izzy...!

Hey, stop it! Right now's not the
time to be fighting!
dialog.translation:
Eh, parad ya! Ahora no es
momento de pelearos!

dialog.english: Hmph! Stupid emails...

We've received another email from
Diablomon!
dialog.translation:
Nos ha llegado otro email de
Diaboromon!

dialog.english:
"WHO'S GOT THE CLOCK?" ...That's
all it says.
dialog.translation:
"QUIÉN TIENE EL RELOJ?"
Y no dice nada más.

dialog.english: The clock?
It's copying itself!
What's that number?
What are we going to do?!
Huh?

I received an email from a
Taiwanese middle school student...
dialog.translation:
Me llegó un email de un
estudiante de secundaria de
Taiwán...

dialog.english:
Thirty minutes ago, an American
military base fired a missile.
dialog.translation:
Hace treinta minutos, base
militar americana lanzó un
misil.

dialog.english: What?!

They said it's a bug in the launch
control computer, but...I'm sure
it's because of this!
dialog.translation:
Dicen que fue un fallo del
ordenador de lanzamiento,
pero seguro que es por esto!

dialog.english: So then, this number would be...

Probably when the missile will hit
its destination...
No way...

Only one missile was fired. Its
name is Peace Keeper.
dialog.translation:
Solo se lanzó un misil. Se
llama Peace Keeper.

dialog.english:
But nobody knows where it's
headed, so it could be going
anywhere...
dialog.translation:
Pero nadie sabe hacia dónde
va, podría caer en
cualquier sitio...

dialog.english:
And in nine minutes, it's going to
explode somewhere in the world...
dialog.translation:
Y en nueve minutos va a
explotar en algún lugar del
mundo...

dialog.english:
How are we going to defeat all of
them?
dialog.translation:
Cómo vamos a vencerlos a
todos?

dialog.english:
Nuclear missiles don't explode if
the fuse in them fails to
activate...
dialog.translation:
Los misiles nucleares no
explotan si el detonador no
se activa...

dialog.english:
If it's trying to play a game with
us, only one of them will have the
clock.
dialog.translation:
Si quiere jugar con
nosotros, solo uno de ellos
tendrá el reloj.

dialog.english:
And if we defeat that one, then we
can stop it...
dialog.translation:
Y si derrotamos a ese,
podremos detenerlo...

dialog.english:
How are we gonna find that one,
then?

We'll just have to take them out,
one at a time...
dialog.translation:
Tendremos que ir
eliminándolos uno a uno...

dialog.english: That's gonna take way too long!
But there's no other way...
Tai... Tai... Tai!
Ah!

Tai! Get yourself together,
Tai! Leave it to me...
dialog.translation:
Tai! Reacciona, Tai! Déjamelo
a mí...

dialog.english: WarGreymon...
Do you know where it is?
MetalGarurumon...
I'll send you the address now!
Please!

Yeah... It's our only choice...
I'm sorry...
dialog.translation:
Sí... Es nuestra única
opción. Lo siento...

dialog.english: No, don't...
We're getting so many emails...

"You can do it, WarGreymon!"
That's from Costa Rica...
dialog.translation:
"Tú puedes, WarGreymon!" Ese
es de Costa Rica...

dialog.english:
From the Philippines, "You gotta
win, MetalGarurumon!"
They're coming in like a flood.

We can't give up... until the
end...
dialog.translation:
No podemos rendirnos
hasta el final.

dialog.english: There's no way we can give up...
How many of them are there?!

Eight thousand... no, sixteen
thousand... It keeps copying
itself!
dialog.translation:
Ocho mil... no, dieciséis
mil... Sigue copiándose!

dialog.english: Aaaaaah!
WarGreymon...

Something's wrong with the way
WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon are
moving!
dialog.translation:
Algo va mal con los
movimientos de WarGreymon y
MetalGarurumon!

dialog.english:
It's because of all the emails
coming from all over the world!
dialog.translation:
Es por todos los emails que
llegan de todo el mundo!

dialog.english:
The sheer amount of emails is
taking up processing speed!
dialog.translation:
Tantos emails están
consumiendo velocidad de
proceso!

dialog.english:
To everyone around the world,
WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon's
response time is too low!
dialog.translation:
A todo el mundo: el tiempo
de respuesta de WarGreymon y
MetalGarurumon es muy bajo!

dialog.english: Please! Stop sending us emails!
Ah...
WarGreymon...
Do you want more tea, Izzy?
Ah, sorry. I'll leave you alone...

It's no use. The emails keep
coming in. We only have five
minutes left, what are we to do?
dialog.translation:
Es inútil. Siguen llegando
emails. Solo quedan cinco
minutos, qué hacemos?

dialog.english: WarGreymon...

MetalGarurumon... It's me,
Matt... Open your eyes...
dialog.translation:
MetalGarurumon... Soy yo,
Matt... Abre los ojos...

dialog.english: I'm here! I'm here, too!

I want to fight with you... I
won't let you fight alone...I'm
here...
dialog.translation:
Quiero luchar contigo... No
te dejaré luchar solo...
Estoy aquí...

dialog.english:
MetalGarurumon... let's fight
together!
WarGreymon and...
MetalGarurumon...
Combined...

There! There's the last one! That
one has the clock!
dialog.translation:
Ahí! Ese es el último!
Ese tiene el reloj!

dialog.english:
Matt! Hurry up and find it! We
don't have time! Hurry!
dialog.translation:
Matt! Date prisa y
encuéntralo! No hay tiempo!
Rápido!

dialog.english: It's too fast...

And it still outclasses us in
power and response time...
dialog.translation:
Y nos supera en potencia
y velocidad de respuesta...

dialog.english: What should I do...
Thirty seconds!
That's it... redirection!

If I redirect all of these emails
to its address...
dialog.translation:
Si redirijo todos estos
emails a su dirección...

dialog.english: Go!

Ten seconds! Nine... eight...
seven... six... five... four...
three... two... one...
Ah! A response?

"Dear Sora, it was my fault, so
don't be angry anymore..."
dialog.translation:
"Querida Sora, fue culpa
mía, no sigas enfadada..."

dialog.english:
"Tai Yagami"...? Oh, what an
idiot!
